questions.question: A 40 kg alloy contains Gold:Copper = 7:3. How much Copper should be added to make Gold:Copper = 2:3?
questions.questionHtml: A 40 kg alloy contains Gold:Copper = 7:3. How much Copper should be added to make Gold:Copper = 2:3?
questions.solution:
Gold = 40 × 7 ÷ 10 = 28 kg

Copper = 40 × 3 ÷ 10 = 12 kg

Let added Copper = x kg

Final ratio:

⇒ 28 : (12 + x) = 2 : 3 ⇒ 28 × 3 = 2 × (12 + x)

⇒ 84 = 24 + 2x ⇒ 84 − 24 = 2x ⇒ 60 = 2x ⇒ x = 30 kg
